description: Provenance and license manifest for every icon, font, sound, cursor, wallpaper, and illustration that ships or is fetched at runtime. A shipped entry must name an existing path, a license, a license text, and a source. Categories with no shipped files stay explicit so the first new asset cannot bypass the gate.

categories.icon: Monochrome glyphs, first-party app artwork, and launcher icons.
categories.font: UI and monospace faces embedded or installed by the desktop.
categories.sound: Startup, alert, notification, volume, error, trash, lock/unlock, and UI feedback sounds.
categories.cursor: XCursor themes loaded at runtime by the compositor.
categories.wallpaper: Bundled default artwork and runtime provider images.
categories.illustration: Original line art used by About, Welcome, and empty states.

assets.name: Inter
assets.install: libs/system-font Qt resource; system-wide fontconfig install is a packaging item
assets.notes: Variable opsz + wght, roman and italic. No Reserved Font Name.

assets.name: Tabler Icons
assets.install: compiled into the design-system QML module as qrc resources
assets.notes: Outline line glyphs plus the pinned filled app marks.

assets.name: Phosphor Icons
assets.install: compiled into the design-system QML module as qrc resources
assets.notes: Regular and fill weights for the Settings category tiles and near-white app marks.

assets.name: First-party app icons
assets.source: generated by scripts/gen-app-icons.py from Tabler filled marks
assets.install: share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps plus the shell qrc payload
assets.notes: One original Dragonfruit app mark per first-party desktop id; no Apple app-icon shapes or colours.

assets.name: Capitaine Cursors
assets.notes: Separable runtime data asset. Compiled XCursor files only; sizes 24/48/96 kept, animated cursors keep one frame, upstream aliases kept as relative symlinks, no pixel changes.

assets.name: Dragonfruit default wallpaper
assets.notes: The only image bundled in a package.

assets.name: Featured pictures and NASA space imagery (runtime provider)
assets.source: Wikimedia Commons Featured Pictures API; NASA Image and Video Library API
assets.license: asset-specific (Wikimedia: public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA, FAL; NASA: public domain under NASA media guidelines)
assets.notice: docs/licensing.md; attribution is shown in the Wallpaper pane
assets.policy: No fetched image is ever shipped. Wikimedia images are downloaded in full during the catalogue fetch; NASA thumbnails are cached and the full original is fetched on demand. The provider stores the license fields verbatim, displays artist/credit + license + page, filters NASA logos/insignia and non-NASA creators, and never relabels a fetched work as Dragonfruit's own.
assets.notes: Share-alike and FAL images remain third-party works. NASA content is credited to NASA/center and linked to the NASA media guidelines; no NASA endorsement is implied.

assets.name: UI sound set
assets.policy: Original or permissively licensed sounds only; no Apple sound files or close derivatives. Every file records source, license, and intended use before merge. The set covers startup, alert, volume feedback, notification, error, trash, lock/unlock, and a small UI click/toggle set.
assets.notes: This entry is intentionally empty: no sound file ships yet.

assets.name: Original illustrations
assets.policy: Original line art only. Device and empty-state illustrations are drawn for Dragonfruit; no Apple product renders, marketing images, or traced Apple artwork. Every file records source, license, and intended use before merge.
assets.notes: Icons and the default wallpaper cover the current artwork; no standalone illustration ships yet.
